summary: Personal Vault MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass covering transactions, events, tasks, reminders, vault, files (upload/list/raw?token/delete via Emergent object storage) and device isolation (data created with one X-Device-Id is not visible to another; cross-device PUT returns 404). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Beranda dashboard, Keuangan (add expense Rp 50.000 → balance Rp -50.000, pie chart renders with Makanan 100%, toast 'Transaksi disimpan'), Jadwal (week strip, segmented Jadwal/Tugas/Alarm, add-jadwal-fab opens sheet), Brankas PIN gate (create 1234 → confirm 1234 → unlocked, toast 'PIN berhasil dibuat'), added vault account (reveal works). No deprecated Expo packages found in app source. No React Native red-screen errors. Only console warnings about deprecated 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' props coming from RN libs (informational).

issues: React Native web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). These originate from third-party RN libs (reanimated / gesture-handler / navigation) rendered on web — not app-authored code. No functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes MongoDB _id via clean() before returning — good.
get_file_raw allows token query param fallback for web preview, which is required because tags cannot send custom headers. Auth is only device_id equality, which matches the no-login product spec.
PUT /vault/{id} returning 404 when the account belongs to a different device is correctly enforced by the {id, device_id} query on the follow-up find_one.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. All tests used TEST_-prefixed data and soft-deleted at the end. A single expense (Rp 50.000, Makanan) remains in the frontend's local device_id because the UI test doesn't clean it up — safe to leave (scoped to that browser).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend backend URL var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — value: https://personal-vault-113.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend requires X-Device-Id header; /api/files/{id}/raw also accepts ?token=<device_id>. Vault PIN flow uses SecureStore key pv_vault_pin persisted per browser — to re-test create-PIN flow on web, clear localStorage first. PinPad exposes testIDs pin-key-0..9 and pin-del.
